title: Keystore DER_MAX: add static assert that RSA-4096 DER fits
description: WP11_KEYSTORE_DER_MAX = 4096 bytes. An RSA-4096 DER private key is ~2350 bytes so there is headroom, but the limit is undocumented and there is no compile-time or runtime assertion. If someone increases the max key size without updating this constant, wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode will fail at runtime with no clear diagnostic. Add a _Static_assert or comment: 'RSA-4096 DER max ~2350 bytes; this constant must be >= that size'.
